description: This shell script defines tests for the 'git reset --patch' command, including setup procedures, various test cases with different arguments, and verifications of repository states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a descriptive message and associated commands.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Initializes and snapshots the repository state for testing.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Simulates user input lines for testing interactive commands.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that a file is in the expected state based on saved snapshot.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies the repository's working directory and HEAD are in the expected state.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the repository's state to specific conditions for testing.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Checks that HEAD has not moved from its saved state.
